title: Spinning blur headline over contracting rings
summary: A two-line headline spins and sharpens out of a heavy blur while it falls back in depth, over concentric rounded rings that keep shrinking. One unbroken 2 s move with a slow middle gives a short claim depth.
use_when: A one-claim feature announcement or availability line
A 2 s sting before or after a longer film
A silent loop for social feeds where one headline is the whole message
Introducing something with a depth or immersion angle

look.type_style: semi-bold grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking, two centred lines, about 10 % of frame height per line; small white wordmark at the bottom, about 3 % H

sfx.event: headline spins and resolves from blur (f3 to f28)

structure.shot: two-line headline (3 words, names the feature) centred over concentric rounded-square rings in blue; small wordmark at the bottom
structure.camera: pull-out on the whole scene: headline width 0.50 W at f15 -> 0.42 W at f30 -> 0.36 W at f60 (about -24 %/s then -21 %/s); rings contract toward the centre at the same rate; roll -15 deg -> 0 at f30 -> +5 deg at f62, one clockwise spin with a slow middle (speed-ramp)
structure.motion: f0-f2 black; headline fades in from f3, blur ~0.15 em -> 0 and roll -15 deg -> 0 on easings.outQuint 25 fr (f3-f28, measured from 30 fps strip); line 2 sharpens 6 fr after line 1; wordmark blur-in f15-f22; rings fade in f5-f12; flat hold f28-f43; from f44 roll and recede accelerate again, easings.inOutSine to the end (about 0.27 deg/fr at f62)

params.brand: any brand.json: display font and fg for the headline, accent for the rings, bg near black
params.content.headline: one statement on 2 lines, 2-4 words total ('\n' = break)
params.content.mark: small wordmark or logo under the headline ('' = none)
params.rings.color: ring stroke, outer rings lighter blue than inner (defaults to brand accent)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Single shot, 0 cuts, no audio in the reference. Measured from 30 fps strips: 3 black frames, entrance f3-f28 (25 fr, deceleration only, no overshoot), line 2 lags line 1 by 6 fr, flat hold f28-f43, then the spin and recede pick up again; rotation and scale never reverse direction (clockwise roll and shrink throughout). Rings are a missing component (ContourRings). Proposed terms not in the vocabulary: spin-resolve, contour-rings. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. Palette from the full-res keyframe at 1.50 s only (no cut frames).
